name: invite_user_with_roles
summary: Invite user to team with roles
description: Roles: PIPELINE_COLLABORATOR, PIPELINE_ADMIN, ACTIVATION_COLLABORATOR, ACTIVATION_ADMIN, MODELS_AND_WORKFLOWS_COLLABORATOR, MODELS_AND_WORKFLOWS_ADMIN, BILLING_ADMIN, TEAM_COLLABORATOR, TEAM_ADMIN, or OBSERVER. Any other value returns a 400.
consequence: Gives the invited user access to your Hevo account with the given roles.
title: Invite user to team with roles
